statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the block threshold while the U.S. data/open and expiration cluster keeps Stress extreme.

headline: WATCH into U.S. data, cash open and expiration
body: Latest NQ data show 29,911.5 versus a 29,966.75 session high and 29,743 prior close, so the contract is positive but off its extreme. Reuters reports a tepid open setup with the 10-year Treasury yield near 4.976% and oil lower. Fresh Finviz breadth is supportive but non-real-time. Persistent failed retracements are not established.
